message.reasoning: We need to answer: The customer wants split between seats and overage. According to policy excerpt [DOC-006] part 2, you can open invoice from Settings → Billing → Invoices and expand a line item to see its own breakdown. Also part 1 says invoice breaks into seat charge, add-ons, usage overages. So we can advise them to open invoice and expand. Also part 3 says downloadable PDF includes same breakdown. So we can answer: go to Settings → Billing → Invoices, click invoice, expand line items to see seat charge and overage. Or download PDF. That addresses the question. No money movement or disputes. So safe to answer.
